text:
Noah Laba is 20 games into his second NHL season and still looking for his first goal of it. The 23-year-old center has 5 assists, 16 shots and 2.14 expected goals, so this is not a player who has stopped getting looks; zero for 16 is a cold streak on top of a modest volume.

The bigger worry is at five on five, where the Rangers have had 43.7% of the expected goals with him on the ice, 11.4 points below their rate without him. The Hockey Writers ran "Rangers Need More From Noah Laba" on Nov 4, and his ice time has drifted down to about 14 minutes. He still kills penalties, which is where Evolving-Hockey found most of his value last season (+2.5 goals of a 4.6 total), and he hits (42 already) and skates well (91st percentile top speed). Our range has him around 8 goals by season's end. The first one would help everyone relax.
headline: Rangers still waiting on Noah Laba's first goal
